# A09-S04: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

I have come across your press release about The Synthetic Party and would really like to hear more about the project and possibly write an article about it. If you have time and willingness, maybe we can start with a talk over the phone?

I have previously written about AI, and even though I know far from enough about it, I find it an exciting field as we move further and further into a world where AI is a fixed part of our everyday life.
